html:
A teacher who led the Sudanese Union party and became the first president of Mali at independence on 22 September 1960.

He first joined Senegal in the short-lived Mali Federation, which broke up in August 1960; he kept the name Mali for his country, after the medieval empire. A socialist and Pan-Africanist, he built state farms and companies, took Mali out of the CFA franc in 1962 and turned to the Soviet bloc. Economic hardship and a harsh party militia turned people against him. On 19 November 1968 Moussa Traore overthrew him, and he died in detention in 1977.
sum: A teacher who led the Sudanese Union party and became the first president of Mali at independence on 22 September 1960.
